nodes.title: Give the ingest writer a bounded queue
nodes.body:
## Decision

Enqueue no longer opens a writer connection of its own. It sends the batch to a bounded queue owned by the writer, and the writer drains that queue on one goroutine.

## Why

The stall in acme/lore#88 came from every worker holding a writer of its own: they queued behind one another until the slowest holder ran out of patience, and the timeout then arrived as a lost batch rather than as pressure the worker could report.

A bounded queue turns that pressure into a slow send. The worker learns that ingest is behind while it still holds the batch, which is the only point where it can do something about it.

## Cost

One draining goroutine caps write throughput at a single core. We measured the ceiling well above what the largest workspace we run produces, so the cap buys the failure mode we want.
